title: The Marriage Portrait
author: Maggie O'Farrell
summary: In sixteenth-century Italy, teenage Lucrezia de' Medici is married to the Duke of Ferrara after her sister's death. At a remote villa she begins to fear for her life. It is based on the story behind Browning's poem My Last Duchess.
readIf: you like richly detailed historical fiction about court life and a woman under threat.
skipIf: you want a fast plot or already dislike books with a foreboding, uneasy mood.
